    • getRoundInventories

      default List<RoundInventory> getRoundInventories()
      Get the inventory snapshots of every player in every finished round. Main thread only. Snapshots of a round are available from MatchRoundEndEvent of that round, and all of them from MatchEndEvent.
      Returns:
      An unmodifiable list sorted by round number, never null. Players offline at round end are missing.
      Since:
      2.6.0

      Get the inventory snapshot of one player in one round. Main thread only.
